cues.zh: 所以這裡不是個別神經元，

cues.zh: 而是一群神經元，整體在統計上能預測類別。至於機制與數學，

cues.zh: 所以統計機制相同，

cues.zh: 只是分類器的邏輯斯迴歸，一次只看一個神經元，

cues.zh: 稀疏探測則同時納入很多神經元的活化。

cues.en: And finally we have regularization.

cues.en: And actually it's not really the case that you're not allowed to have any regularization on a logistic classifier.

cues.zh: 也就是許多係數設為零，只允許相對少數係數非零。

cues.zh: 稀疏探測的做法是，對 k 個神經元，例如 3,000 個 MLP 擴張神經元，k 就等於 3,000，

cues.en: the neurons, such that their weighted combination best predicts whether a token is from category one or category two or whatever, two different categories.
cues.zh: 讓加權結果，最能預測 token 來自類別一或類別二，總之兩個不同類別。

cues.en: And how do we actually get these beta coefficients?
cues.zh: 實際如何取得 beta 係數？

cues.en: That comes from defining a loss function that looks like this.
cues.zh: 先定義這樣的損失函數。

cues.en: So this is the general loss function for a logistic regression when you want to regularize the regression.
cues.zh: 這是邏輯斯迴歸的一般損失函數。想要正規化迴歸時，

cues.en: You have another loss function which looks something like this.

cues.en: That is for the regularizer loss function.
cues.zh: 表示正規化項的損失函數。

cues.en: And here you sum over all of the absolute values of the beta coefficients.
cues.zh: 將所有 beta 係數的絕對值加總。

cues.en: The impact of this regularizer term is that a lot of the coefficients will go to zero, and a relatively small number of them will remain non-zero.
cues.zh: 這個正規化項的效果，是讓很多係數變成零，只有相對少數維持非零。

cues.en: So this is called L1.
cues.zh: 這稱為 L1。

cues.en: And actually if you square these beta coefficients up here instead of taking the absolute value, that would be an L2 regularizer.
cues.zh: 其實，如果改成將 beta 係數平方，而不是取絕對值，就是 L2 正規化。

cues.en: Anyway, so now the idea is that we want to find the set of betas that minimizes the loss function and also the regularizer loss function.

cues.zh: lambda 越大，模型就越著重於強制稀疏性。

cues.en: And of course when lambda is zero then you just have the normal logistic regression with no regularization.
cues.zh: 當然，lambda 為零，就成為沒有正規化的一般邏輯斯迴歸。

cues.zh: 順帶一提，加入 L1 正規化，也稱為 Lasso 迴歸；L2 則稱為 Ridge 迴歸。
